full_text:
If you cannot monitor your LLM latency and virality score metrics, you are operating in the dark.

Silent failures in background queue workers go unnoticed until user engagement collapses.

Exposing Prometheus metrics on /metrics via prometheus-fastapi-instrumentator provides real-time telemetry into request latency and queue depth.

Zero mystery. Total operational visibility.

How are you monitoring microservices health in your AI infrastructure?
